title: A humongous bridge that goes across an entire ocean leading out of mallworld into another world / city / place.
content: This has been in so many of my mallworld dreams. This AI generated image is so similar to how it looks in my dreams. Sometimes the bridge is open air and swaying (even though it’s metal and a really futuristic metal strong structure). And sometimes it has a glass tunnel. It always goes for miles and miles and takes an age to cross. Usually in my dreams, I am leaving mallworld and attempting a trek back home to where I reside but I have to get across this bridge in order to get there, which is difficult. Anyone else seen this bridge?
